cc:Work.dc:title: FieldIssue synthetic TabPFN learning curve
cc:Work.dc:description: Fixed 500-row test, five training repeats at six sizes. Oracle probabilities are the Bayes rule in expectation. Intervals exclude test-population uncertainty.
